# Texas’ Equal Parts Raises $23M to Support Acquisition Strategy

 February 11, 2026 

Equal Parts, an Austin, Texas-based insurance agency startup, announced it has raised $23M in Series A funding led by Inspired Capital. The investment will accelerate the company’s acquisition strategy and further develop AI tools that extend the reach and impact of independent agencies.

The company plans to acquire 25 agencies this year and reach $1B in premiums within 24 months.

The Series A round, with participation from Equal Ventures, Max Ventures, Genius Ventures and lending partners, brings Equal Parts’ total acquisition capital to $50M. Recent acquisitions include Strategic Insurance in New Mexico and Austin-based Assurely and Lumen Insurance.

# Equal Parts Secures $23M in Series A Funding

-

February 11, 2026

Equal Parts, an Austin, TX-based provider of an insurance platform for independent agencies, raised $23M in Series A funding.

The round was led by Inspired Capital with participation from Equal Ventures, Max Ventures, Genius Ventures, and others, bringing its total acquisition capital to $50M.

Recent acquisitions included Strategic Insurance in New Mexico and the Austin-based agencies Assurely and Lumen Insurance.

The company intends to use the funds to expand footprint and further enhance its platform.

Led by CEO Mike Witte, Equal Parts is a provider of an insurance platform that partners with independent agencies to accelerate growth through technology, capital and operational support. By combining advanced automation with a network of entrepreneurial leaders, it helps agencies improve their operations while maintaining their independence and community focus.
